editorial.blurb: A dedicated biryani specialist in Chicago's downtown digital kitchen corridor, Biryani Ka Adda earns devoted regulars with its carefully balanced spices and authentically aromatic rice.
editorial.insiderTip: Order online for pickup at this digital kitchen location—call ahead if spice sensitivity is a concern, as even 'mild' orders have run unexpectedly hot for some diners; the Chicken 65 Biryani comes highly praised when execution is on point.
